plan.purpose: Separate-review accepted-offer corroboration using existing labels; no claim of verified worker starts.
plan.split: Reuse original deterministic global text-hash partitions: original-convergence-20261019|hash for primary Glassdoor, 20261101:hash for Revelio. All identical narrative hashes stay in one group, even across companies. Report A-to-B and B-to-A.
plan.data: Unchanged original ghost_two labels, and existing complete classified Revelio cohorts. All known offer statuses eligible. Normalize original interview+application text as in existing check; >=20 chars. Deduplicate company/year/narrative hash/outcome in each collection before splitting. No new classification or paid API.
plan.sample: At least ten scoring reviews and five comparison reviews in each company-year; test minimum counts include offers. All three offer statuses known. Source dates: original calendar years, Revelio issuer fiscal years.
plan.predictors: Broad raw ghost-flag share in scoring reviews; conditional ghost share among scoring no-offer reviews as fixed sensitivity. Do not alter feature weights, offer-zero convention or labels.
plan.outcomes: Primary: accepted-offer count divided by all comparison reviews. Secondary: accepted-plus-declined offer count divided by all comparison reviews. Never use scoring-review offer outcomes as the comparison outcome.
plan.descriptive: Primary collection uses bottom/top scoring quartiles including ties, as its existing separate-review check; Revelio uses above-median versus at-or-below-median scores. Groups determined solely by scoring reviews. Company-year records weighted by comparison review counts for rates.
continuous_models: broad score + scoring offer share + log scoring count + log mean scoring narrative length + time/industry effects (primary)
broad score + same scoring controls + company/year effects
ghost share among scoring no-offer reviews + same scoring controls + time/industry effects
plan.effects: Original: Year FE because no verified industry link for every source folder. Revelio: SIC2 industry and Year FE. Company/year sensitivity uses source employer in primary and linked GVKEY in Revelio.
plan.inference: WLS weighted by comparison review counts; firm-cluster finite-sample covariance and t(G-1). Primary four adjusted continuous accepted-offer tests (two collections x two directions) receive Holm adjustment. Secondary any-offer tests receive separate Holm-four adjustment. Also report Holm across all 32 model terms. Direction reversals reuse observations, not independent replications.
plan.bootstrap: 1999 whole-company bootstrap draws for raw high-minus-low rate gaps, with fixed scoring groups and paired company weights across directions within collection. Both accepted and any-offer outcomes retained.
plan.interpretation: Expected sign is negative. Cross-review separation removes direct outcome reuse but does not eliminate persistent company offer rates, review selection or applicant acceptance choices. Accepted offers do not prove a job start. Repeated same-year applicants are not a six-month posting match.
